name: Lifetime Award
text: Whenever you gain contract value from another sigil, gain +5 more.

signature.trigger: you gain contract value from another sigil

family: When played and re-triggers / Repeat (earlier payouts)
decision: Shopping: every small contract-value sigil is now worth +5 more each time it pays, so many small triggers beat one big one.
opponent: Each extra +5 is shown with the gain it follows.
aiNote: Value each contract-value sigil at +5 more per expected trigger when shopping.
rationale: A Bonus Chaser round collects five to eight separate contract-value gains (Opening Bell, Golden Ticket, Chasing Rainbows, Crown Jewel, Rebel Graffiti), so this adds about +25 to +40, about +25 EV after failed contracts, inside the rare band. A flat bonus per gain is easier to track than a running total.
deviation: Redesigned from a king-affinity payout equal to the round's contract value so far, up to +60, into a flat bonus on each gain.
